intelligence.description: Kraken is a global digital-asset platform spanning trading, custody, payments, and tokenized assets.
company: Kraken operates a global digital-asset platform spanning spot trading, derivatives, custody, payments, and tokenized equities.
It announced $800 million in financing in November 2025; the Citadel Securities strategic-investment tranche was executed at a $20 billion valuation.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Kraken is a major private-market proxy for institutional adoption of digital-asset infrastructure. Its expansion into multiple financial products makes its execution relevant beyond crypto trading alone.

changed.text: Announced $800M financing; Citadel tranche at $20B valuation.

takeaways: The Citadel Securities tranche set a disclosed $20B valuation.
Kraken reported $1.5B of revenue in 2024 and said it surpassed that level within the first three quarters of 2025.
Market cycles and regulatory outcomes remain central risks.
